_open_question: Existing ET9 turbine SKUs follow <digits><letters> -> ET9<digits> (e.g. 900FH -> ET90900, 500FG2 -> ET95002). FH23029 is <letters><digits>, which the deterministic mapping in run_068_enforce_turbine_et9.js and validate-et9-precarga.js does not cover. Two options were proposed to the user, awaiting decision: (1) ET9 + last digits of 23029 (e.g. ET93029) — risk: collides with the ET930xx-ET93223 HYDROCORE(tm) range already in use; (2) a distinct sub-block for the Fuel Pro FH2xxxx series (e.g. ET9FH23029) to avoid mixing ranges with a different technology.
